key_notes: Key 1 (t=6.13s): Initial archival pose of the-eiffel-tower; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=7.25s): Mid-sequence articulation of the-eiffel-tower; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=8.49s): Peak dynamic extension of the-eiffel-tower over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=9.73s): Follow-through and settle of the-eiffel-tower with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of the-eiffel-tower (6.13s..9.73s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
